mechanism: Etanercept (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases infection risk while piperacillin-tazobactam is an antibiotic; concurrent use requires careful monitoring for treatment efficacy and adverse effects in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor for adequate infection response and clinical improvement; ensure appropriate antibiotic dosing; consider discontinuing or holding etanercept during acute serious infections, particularly in severely immunocompromised patients.
